## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, the change, and the affected implementation (research v2,
legacy, or shared documentation). Link related issues when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Note checks you could not
run and why. For documentation changes, link and source review may be sufficient.

## Review notes

Mention relevant limitations, configuration changes, and third-party dependencies.
Attach UI screenshots only with synthetic or de-identified content. Do not
include patient data, credentials, model weights, or local case databases.
